energy_accounting.study_energy_disclosure: Verified software tests and analytical models; no bare-metal power meter used.

claims.statement: Modern computers stack many separate software layers, and today's AI agents are bolted on top without changing the floor underneath.
None of those underlying layers asks, before an agent acts, how much energy the action will spend or whether it fits.
A machine built for agents must meter energy honestly, grant strict budgets, and refuse any action that breaks its limit.

easy_read.easy_title: An Operating System Built for Energy Budgets
three_points_one_idea_sentences: This study is about an operating system built for energy budgets.
Modern computers stack many separate software layers, and today's AI agents are bolted on top without changing the floor underneath.
None of those underlying layers asks, before an agent acts, how much energy the action will spend or whether it fits.
A machine built for agents must meter energy honestly, grant strict budgets, and refuse any action that breaks its limit.
Key result: 310 Passing Rust Tests · 78,400 Provenance Checks.
Clear math and public price records checked every number.
